name: UTSSites Auto FAQ Schema
author: utssites

sections.description:
UTSSites Auto FAQ Schema scans your post and page content for question-style headings and automatically injects a valid FAQPage JSON-LD schema block into your head — making your content eligible for Google FAQ rich snippets with zero configuration.

Free Features

  • Auto Question Detection — H2, H3, H4, H5 headings
  • Paragraph <p> tag detection
  • Bold / Strong tag detection
  • Detect questions without “?” (configurable)
  • 40+ question patterns (How, What, Why, When, Where, Who…)
  • Hash-based duplicate removal
  • Live JSON-LD Preview in settings page
  • Per-post disable toggle
  • Exclude specific pages by ID
  • Up to 5 FAQs per page (free plan)
  • FAQPage JSON-LD schema (Google compliant)

Pro Version

A Pro version with additional features is available at https://utssites.com/plugin/wordpress-faq-schema-plugin/

Pro features include: Unlimited FAQs, Manual FAQ Builder, AI FAQ Suggestions, Google Safe Mode, HowTo + QAPage Schema, Duplicate Detector, Analytics Dashboard, and more.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the utssites-auto-faq-schema folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to UTSSites Auto FAQ Schema settings to configure
  4. Plugin works automatically on all new and existing posts
sections.faq:
Does this require any manual FAQ setup?

No. The plugin automatically detects questions and answers from your existing content.

Which heading levels are scanned?

By default H2, H3, and H4. You can also enable H5. Bold/strong text and paragraph tags are also detected.

Will it affect page speed?

No. The schema is a tiny JSON-LD script tag added to the head with zero impact on render performance.

Can I disable it for specific pages?

Yes. Each post/page has a meta box in the editor with a per-post disable toggle.

How many FAQs does the free version support?

The free version supports up to 5 FAQs per page. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited FAQs.
